leads: XERV is known as a custom software agency established by a team of five seasoned IT professionals who share a common passion for innovation and excellence. With years of experience in the tech industry, we have built a streamlined organisation that thrives on collaboration and adaptability.
As to our XERV manifesto, we stand ready to be your trustworthy partner and provide IT services in a clear, understandable and effective approach.

direction.vision: To be the go-to custom software agency that empowers developers, fosters innovation, and provides exceptional value to clients through scalable, impactful and efficient software solutions.
direction.mission: Create a flexible workspace for full-time and part-time collaborators. Provide opportunities for developers to enhance their skills and advance their careers. Develop customised solutions that solve complex challenges and drive client success.
